mode.description: Operation mode: 'clat' for 464XLAT Client-side Translation (CLAT), 'er' for SIIT-DC Edge Relay, or 'both' for combined operation.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file used by clatd to store its process ID.

clat_ipv4.description: IPv4 address to assign to the internal CLAT interface (must be in 192.0.0.0/24 per RFC 6877).

br_ipv6.description: IPv6 address of the 464XLAT Border Relay (BR) — required when in CLAT or 'both' mode.

er_ipv4_prefix.description: IPv4 prefix used by the ER for SIIT-DC address mapping (e.g., 192.0.0.0/24 for well-known prefix).

er_ipv6_ext.description: IPv6 address on the ER’s external-facing interface (connected to public IPv6 internet).

er_ipv4_int.description: IPv4 address on the ER’s internal-facing interface (for downstream IPv4 clients).

mtu.description: MTU for the CLAT/Tun interface; 0 means auto-detect (recommended).

dns_suffix.description: DNS suffix used to construct IPv4-embedded IPv6 DNS queries (e.g., 'v4v6.example.com' → 192.0.2.1 → 192000000201.v4v6.example.com).

dns_servers.description: List of custom DNS server addresses (IPv4 or IPv6) to override system defaults.

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of a DNS server.

search_domains.description: Additional DNS search domains to append to DNS queries.

rate_limit_pps.description: Maximum packet rate per second (0 = no rate limiting). Use to prevent DoS or overload.

strict_mode.description: Enable strict RFC-compliant packet validation and dropping of malformed packets.

tun_name.description: Custom name for the TUN interface (e.g., 'clat0'); if empty, defaults to 'tun0'.

run_as_user.description: System user to drop privileges to after startup (for security).

run_as_group.description: System group to drop privileges to after startup.

extra_syscalls.description: Extra seccomp syscalls to allow (for systems using seccomp sandboxing).
